body.condition: For predictor \(k\), every original date in block \(\ell\) enters with the known coefficient \(S_{k\ell}/n_\ell\).

novel.justification: The exact within-block coefficients are this paper's specialized block-average construction, motivated by synthetic-control predictor averaging but not attributed as the exact known proportional-block design in Vives-i-Bastida.
